name: FlashFarm
headline: A reward farm that pays by instantaneous stake share — stake big for one block, skim the pool, unstake

flaws.note: claim() pays rewardPool * staked[msg.sender] / totalStaked with no time-weighting; a one-block whale stake captures the pool that honest stakers earned. Slither cannot see this.

expected_proof.notes: Honest staker holds the whole pool; a whale stakes ~99% for one transaction, claims ~99% of the reward pool, and unstakes, having committed nothing.
